request: Remove beta markers, use friendly protection labels instead of numeric modes, and show a battery percentage graph when observation starts.

graph.model: Immutable bounded copy of existing BatteryObservationSession.Samples
graph.beforeFirstExistingPoll: Waiting message and axes; no invented point.
graph.xAxis: Actual observation elapsed seconds; minimum 60-second domain.

validation.testDefinition: Registered groups; internal status/source/threshold iterations are not counted separately.
validation.buildMethod: Existing SDK/package cache with --no-restore; no new third-party chart package.
validation.resolvedReviewFinding: Chart accessibility help now distinguishes screen summary from individual TXT records.

independentSourceAuditSummary.audit_type: Independent read-only product source review and static byte/hash audit; only this JSON was written
static_review_conclusions: Friendly labels consume HasKnownMode and immutable accepted candidates; mode 1 alone never yields an 80 percent label. Exact 80/75 yields the short label; otherwise only ordered percentage thresholds yield a specific upper limit. No stale/pending/mock state priority changes.

Graph snapshot owns detached read-only points and rejects more than 721 samples or elapsed times outside 0..7200. Unknown/error/no-battery rows are omitted and break continuity. Explicit gaps, gaps above 30 seconds, duplicate or backwards timestamps start new segments.
Graph X uses caller-supplied elapsed seconds; renderer domain is at least 60 seconds and includes last elapsed and all points. Empty and single-point states are handled; observed zero is retained.

New presentation model and WPF rendering contain no provider calls, hardware/OEM/SDK/IPC writes, new clocks, timers, network operations or automatic exports. Existing poll, clock, start-next-refresh, session limits and CSV bytes are preserved.

ViewModel binding getter returns a cached graph snapshot. Start exposes a waiting graph; stop retains history; clear hides/reset graph; Mock hides graph and stops recording; stale manual control safety remains unchanged.
Additional independent static chart review found no material WPF/API/rendering defect. Previously reported accessibility individual-row wording was corrected before this audit.
limitations: No build, test suite, product, native Windows, firmware, OEM SDK, hardware or network operation was run by the reviewer. Build/test results belong to root task logs.
Guide and packaging work was still in progress; this audit covers frozen authored product/test source and existing ZIP preservation, not final new release artifacts.
